newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-IAMA eyes Dairy Vale supply stores.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-IAMA eyes Dairy Vale supply stores.

text.p: IAMA Ltd said on Monday it had commenced discussions with dairy company Dairy Vale Ltd to buy Dairy Vale's five rural supplies stores which operate in the Fleurieu Peninsula region of South Australia.
The transaction was expected to lead to operational benefits for both companies, IAMA said.
The company said it would use its merchandise and management expertise to develop the Dairy Vale rural supplies business and expand on the product and services range offered to customers.

"The transaction will enable Dairy Vale, a major South Australian milk processor, to redirect the capital previously employed in the rural supplies business to its core dairy operations with the aim of improving returns to shareholders," IAMA said in a statement.
The transaction was subject to the satisfactory conclusion of due diligence by IAMA and the completion of legal documentation, IAMA said.
Dairy Vale Ltd is 46.2 percent owned by Dairy Vale Investment Trust.
